content.short: Furucombo is a multi-chain DeFi aggregator that simplifies, optimizes, and automates DeFi trading.
content.description: Furucombo started as a drag‑and‑drop tool to help users optimize their DeFi strategies, and it has since evolved into a DeFi portal for boosting your crypto wealth. It enables you to build DeFi combos that cover multi‑send token airdrops via CSV uploads, bridge and trade multiple tokens at once, and manage lending positions with flash loans, along with additional capabilities that streamline DeFi workflows.
